Good Food, Cold Beer and a Mellow Vibe
Dec 2019
We popped by the alley cafe after a friends recommendation and we were glad we'd found this hidden gem tucked on a quite alley of the main strip (hence the name). 

Food was good and quite cheap, 40k VND for a lovely bowl of Pho, 60K for a nice Bratwurst hot dog...basically a good balance between Western and Vietnamese traditional food. 

Most importantly the beers were ice cold and the bar was complete with mainly expats who were all quite sociable. 

I'd recommend this especially if you're looking for a sort of mature/chilled vibe, it's definitely an older crowd.

One of the best hangouts in all Vietnam
Aug 2019 • Couples
ALL TO OURSELVES...

...is how we had it, just long enough, at our new favorite hangout, Alley Café. 

EFFING cold beers - great music - John, Jenny, Tom & the rest of the crew made us feel right at home from the moment we first got here - such a chill and relaxing vibe - it’s quiet and the music is played so you can talk to the person next to you. Right now there are seven adorable puppies, and they all have homes! 

This is our second time for the food, and we LOVE it! 

What we had:

Stacey - a huge chicken Cesar salad (she says it’s the best one she’s ever had)

Sky: fried spring rolls & a delectable green salad with homemade Italian vinaigrette￼ dressing 

Both: Saigon export, better than the original for just a couple thousand dong more
